claims.text: Brindle Group seeks a partner to rationalise a sprawling application estate and migrate priority workloads to cloud.

The scope includes baselining the application estate, defining a target architecture, building a wave‑based decommissioning plan, migrating priority workloads with no unplanned downtime, and reducing annual run cost.
We will begin with a Diagnose phase to baseline the application estate and define a target architecture.
In the Design phase we will develop a wave‑based decommissioning plan that aligns with business priorities.
The Deliver phase will execute the migration of priority workloads to the public cloud using a zero‑unplanned‑downtime approach proven in prior work.

Throughout the engagement we will apply VCG’s four‑phase methodology, governed by a joint steering committee that meets fortnightly and overseen by an Engagement Quality Director for engagements longer than six months.
Knowledge transfer workshops will be run in the final four weeks to ensure client teams can sustain the new environment.
Success will be measured against the RFP goals of reduced annual run cost, stable migration, and a clear decommission schedule.
VCG rationalised Kestrel Logistics’ application estate from 214 applications to 96, delivering a target architecture and a three‑wave decommissioning plan within the first 10 weeks.
The Kestrel engagement reduced annual run cost by 19 percent over 18 months.
VCG migrated 68 workloads to a public cloud for Denhoff Media over seven months with zero unplanned downtime.
The Denhoff migration lowered infrastructure cost by 22 percent and increased deployment frequency from monthly to weekly.
VCG has delivered 340 engagements since 2020 with a client repeat‑engagement rate of 68 percent, demonstrating trusted relationships.
Our proven rationalisation and migration outcomes align directly with the client’s objectives of cost reduction and uninterrupted migration.
The four‑phase delivery methodology ensures disciplined execution, governance, and knowledge transfer, reducing risk for complex estate transformations.
With 2,000 consultants across six practices and an average team size of seven, VCG can allocate the right mix of strategy and technology expertise to this program.
A repeat‑engagement rate of 68 percent indicates strong client satisfaction and the likelihood of a successful partnership.
